profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Roku Inc.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Implemented some of IEEE 802.11 protocols in MLME layer for Samsung Mobile Handsets which can be involved in Galaxy J5 prime 2016. All implemented protocols were written in C and these features can increase performance (up to 100%) and also can reduce power consumption (up to 50%) of mobile handsets.
•	Senior Software Engineer
•	Implemented 802.11 protocols in C
◦	TDLS, P2P Channel Switch, P2P NOA (Notice Of Absence) 
•	Implemented Feature Test Script in Perl
◦	C, Perl, Bash, IEEE802.11abgn, Wi-Fi Direct 2.0, T32

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Wireless Display Solution Design and Implementation for Samsung Mobile
Developed a Wireless Display Solution based on Wireless USB protocol in C. This solution was the first solution which can show a FULL-HD resolution to a bigger screen like a TV from Android Mobile Handsets. This solution had been shown in CES2012. (https://youtu.be/49Y5SLQNOvo)
•	Implemented the Wireless Display Solution 
•	Customized the solution for Samsung Mobile
◦	C, Java, USB Linux Device Driver, T32, Android SDK, Android NDK, USB Protocol Analyzer(Lecroy, Ellisys)

I-Rider: A set-top box on bicycle for visually impaired people
Developed a set-top box on a bicycle for visually impaired people using USB, Arduino, 2 Webcams on Android platform. This set-top box can make a visually impaired person ride a bicycle without any helps from others. The set-top box provides various sounds to the rider about blockers in front of the bicycle. The core visual processing solution is based on OpenCV which also was ported to Android.
•	Technical Leader
•	Designed the Software Architecture
◦	C, Android SDK, Android NDK, Arduino Uno, USB Linux Device Driver

positions.title: Assistant Software Engineer
positions.description:
FTL for Wireless Mass Storage Design and Implementation
Developed the Flash Translate Layer(FTL) for the Wireless Mass Storage product in C. This was implemented on FPGA because there’s no SoC solutions for this produce at that time. With this FTL on FPGA, Read/Write throughput was about 8Mbps, so this can be up to 32Mbps on SoC solution because the FPGA is 4 times slower than SoC.
◦	C, NAND Flash, FTL Algorithm, T32, FAT16/32 File system

Boot loader Development
Developed a boot loader for WUSB SoC. The architecture of boot loader is that instruction code is located in NOR Flash and data is located in RAM using scatter-gather method. With the NOR Flash, the booting time is reduced because no need to copy instruction code to RAM.
◦	C, Arm Architecture, NOR Flash, T32

WUSB association feature Implementation
Developed the WUSB association feature using USB 2.0 protocol. The purpose of this functionality is to communicate key values for wireless security.
◦	C, USB2.0 Protocol, LibUsb, T32, USB Protocol Analyzer (Lecroy, Ellisys)
